_comment: Multi-UAV PPO with the network-consistent reward (reward_mode 'network', see ml/network_model.py). The original training scenarios have no placement headroom for usable ns-3 links (the fixed layout already reaches every user), so two TRAINING-ONLY scenarios with larger extents are added. They use different user distributions (clustered / edge_heavy) from the held-out wide_area (uniform random) and are not part of configs/scenarios.json. Held-out evaluation scenarios are unchanged. random_start_prob: share of training episodes that start from uniformly random UAV positions instead of the fixed layout, so the policy has to learn repositioning.

sparse_clusters.name: Sparse Survivor Clusters (training only)
sparse_clusters.purpose: Training-only: separated survivor clusters over a mid-size area.

wide_edge.name: Wide Area, Edge-Heavy (training only)
wide_edge.purpose: Training-only: users concentrated near the edges of a large area.
